metadata.network_mode: TLS over two separate local TCP listeners in one process
metadata.transport: TLS 1.2+ encrypted stream with verified server certificate/hostname; no client certificate
metadata.warning: This demonstrates server certificate and hostname verification plus TLS confidentiality/integrity. The listeners still run on one machine/process; the global endpoint rate limit is not per-client, does not prevent distributed abuse, and is not a substitute for edge protection. No remote operator independence, authenticated database update protocol, verifiable server computation, anonymous-network circuit, or protection from two-server collusion is proved.
